summary: IDOT concurred with BOR's response, noting that the coordination request covered both the Roosevelt School property and the Forest Preserve District temporary construction easement, and that a telephone conversation with BOR's Bob Frantz confirmed no additional response would be forthcoming on the Forest Preserve property given the well-documented coordination efforts.
text:
4(a) Concur - It is to be noted that our request not only concerned the Roosevelt School property but also an involvement with the Cook County Forest Preserve District by way of a temporary construction easement.
In telephone conversation with Mr. Bob Frantz of the Bureau of Outdoor Recreation on November 14, 1974, Mr. Frantz said no additional response would be forthcoming concerning the Cook County Forest Preserve Property since the material submitted for early coordination and our cooperative efforts with the Forest Preserve District were well documented.
